shadowSentences: I love to read books every day.
The weather is perfect for a picnic.
She enjoys playing the guitar in her free time.
We should travel to new places this year.
He always finds time to help his friends.
Cooking can be a fun and creative activity.
I prefer to listen to music while studying.
Meeting new people can lead to interesting experiences.
Exploring different cultures expands our understanding of the world.
Learning a new language opens up many opportunities for communication.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you describe your last travel experience?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is travel for personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly living.
questions: Q1: What changes have you made in your life to be more eco-friendly?
Q2: What do you find most difficult about living sustainably?
Q3: How do you feel about the importance of environmental protection?
Q4: What tips would you share for someone looking to reduce their carbon footprint?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about internet safety.
questions: Q1: Can you share an experience related to online security?
Q2: What concerns do you have about your online privacy?
Q3: In your opinion, how serious is the issue of cybercrime today?
Q4: What advice would you give others to stay safe online?
